## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Apply the new minimum to invitation passwords before merge; that path still accepts eight-character passwords.

## Changes
The pull request raises signup and reset password minimums from eight to twelve characters and updates their boundary tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Apply the twelve-character minimum to invitations — An eight-character invitation password remains accepted despite the stated twelve-character requirement. The unchanged app/invite.py:1 retains a minimum of 8, and tests/test_invite.py:8 explicitly expects that acceptance. — Users creating passwords through invitations can bypass the new minimum and choose passwords rejected by signup and reset. — Fix: Update the invitation validator and extend tests/test_invite.py for the twelve-character boundary.
